help.title: How It Works
help.auto_saves_desc: No need to tap a save button — just type your predicted score and it's saved automatically after a moment.
help.lock_window_desc: Once locked, your pick is final for that match. Make sure you've submitted before the deadline.
help.change_prediction: You can update your pick anytime before the lock
help.change_prediction_desc: Head to My Picks and edit your predicted score up until 30 minutes before kickoff.
help.knockout_stages: Knockout matches fill in as the tournament progresses
help.knockout_stages_desc: Round of 16, Quarterfinals, Semis, and Final teams are determined after the group stage concludes — you'll be able to predict them then.
help.live_results: Live scores update in near real-time
help.live_results_desc: The leaderboard refreshes every 20 seconds, and the compare view refreshes every 30 seconds during live matches.
help.knockout_scoring: Knockout scores count up to 120 minutes
help.knockout_scoring_desc: For knockout matches, your prediction is compared to the score after 90 minutes + extra time. If you predicted 1–1 and the game ends 1–1 after extra time — even if it then goes to a penalty shootout — that counts as an exact score. Penalty shootout results never affect your points.
help.calendar_page_desc: The Calendar page shows all World Cup fixtures in month or week view. Use the team filter to track a specific country's schedule. Matches are colour-coded by tournament stage.
help.stats_page_desc: The Stats page shows live tournament numbers — total goals, goals per game, goals by stage and group, top attack and defence rankings, and a score distribution chart.
help.export_calendar_desc: From the Dashboard, tap 'Add to Calendar' to download an .ics file or send it to your email. Kickoff times are adjusted to your timezone.

scoringHelp.title: How Scoring Works
scoringHelp.subtitle: Points are awarded based on how close your prediction is to the real result.
scoringHelp.cat_exact_desc: You predicted the exact final scoreline.
scoringHelp.cat_winner_desc: You got the match outcome right — home win, away win, or draw.
scoringHelp.cat_diff_desc: The goal margin matches — e.g. you predicted a +1 win and it was a +1 win.
scoringHelp.cat_one_team_desc: At least one team's exact goal count matches your prediction.
scoringHelp.exclusivity_desc: If you nail the exact scoreline, you earn only the Exact Score points. The other categories do not add on top.
scoringHelp.stacking_desc: If your prediction isn't exact, the remaining three categories can all add up on the same prediction.
scoringHelp.note: Point values depend on each league's rules. Check the Scoring Rules bar inside your league for the exact values.
scoringHelp.knockout_desc: Predictions are compared to the score after 90 minutes + extra time. If you predicted 1–1 and the game finishes 1–1 after extra time — even if it goes to a penalty shootout — that counts as an Exact Score. Penalty shootout results do not affect your prediction.
